cards.title: The chemist counter is where care happens
cards.body: For many families, the chemist uncle is the most regular health contact. AICA is built with that counter at the centre, not as an afterthought.

cards.title: Chemists see every refill
cards.body: Patients may see a doctor every few months, but they visit the chemist for every refill. That's where the prescription thread naturally lives.

cards.title: Handwriting is a daily headache
cards.body: Reading rushed handwriting is part of the job. AICA gives pharmacies AI help reading prescriptions, so the counter spends less time squinting.

cards.title: Refills shouldn't depend on memory
cards.body: AICA predicts when a patient's medicines are likely to run out, helping pharmacies bring them back to the same counter.

cards.title: Trust stays local
cards.body: The idea isn't to replace the neighbourhood chemist. It's to help the counter people already trust keep its patients.

cards.title: Free for founding pharmacies
cards.body: Founding pharmacies use AICA free during the pilot, starting in Lucknow. Nothing is charged today. Join the waitlist at aicaglobal.in.

takeaway: Chemists see every refill, so AICA starts there, with AI handwriting help and refill predictions that keep patients at their counter.
share: Chemist in Lucknow? AICA's founding pharmacy pilot is free. Details at aicaglobal.in
